The tetragonal phase TbZnTe3 (space group I-4m2, No. 119) has a 20-atom unit cell containing four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Tb centers surrounded by 16 neighbors (8 Te and 8 Zn), while Zn centers have 8 Te neighbors and Te centers have 9 neighbors (2 Tb, 2 Zn, 5 Te). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Te 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner/face sharing between Tb 16-vertex and Te 9-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
